QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_17

question.text: A distributor without a valid ARN number __________.

answer.text: Cannot sell mutual fund schemes or earn commissions
Can still sell schemes but earns lower commission
Can sell schemes but only through bank branches
Can sell schemes for the first 6 months without ARN

explanation.text: The Logic: A valid ARN is mandatory for distributing mutual fund schemes. Without it, a person cannot legally sell mutual funds or earn any commission. The ARN proves that the distributor has the required NISM certification and is registered with AMFI. The Trap: There is no grace period or partial permission. Either you have a valid ARN or you cannot distribute mutual funds. No exceptions. Cross-Exam Context: Also tested in Series V-A. ARN validity is a strict regulatory requirement. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always keep your ARN active by renewing your NISM certification before it expires. If your ARN lapses, you will stop earning trail commission on existing investments too.
